chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 11 – Ji Ning Learns the Thirteen Sword Forms Under a Stern Father
chapter_meta_description: Ji Yichuan drills his son through a million sword thrusts and a million blocks. One year later, Ji Ning becomes a master archer capable of four arrows at once. The foundations of a sword god are laid.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 11 – The Thirteen Foundations
og_description: Ji Yichuan forces Ji Ning to practice the thirteen basic sword forms until they become bone-deep instinct. After a year of brutal training, Ji Ning emerges as a peerless shot with the bow.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 11 – A Million Thrusts
twitter_description: Ji Ning spends a year drilling the basics: a million thrusts, a million blocks, and a new mastery of the bow. The grind is real, but so are the gains.
